uniqueAngle.existingConsensus: Reps quit over comp, territory, and bad managers — monitoring tools are an annoyance, not an attrition driver.
uniqueAngle.keelClaim: Surveillance tooling is a quiet attrition driver, because it converts selling into being evaluated — and the best reps, who have the most options, leave first.
uniqueAngle.supportingReason: Attrition follows autonomy loss. Top performers experience monitoring as distrust of judgment they've already proven, so the tools installed to protect revenue quietly leak its best producers.
